description.zh: 盯住第一张紫色卡，看左下角起止色值和复制图标 Design Gradients是双色线性渐变目录，原站标注48组，色卡展示起止HEX与复制入口。网页自称免费，具体许可与商业用途范围未核；色值和CSS背景设计数据不等于该平台程序源码。
description.en: Design Gradients is a gallery of linear gradients, described by its site as 48 curated pairs. Cards show endpoint hex values and copying controls. The platform calls itself free; license and commercial-use scope remain unverified. Color values and CSS background data do not establish access to the platform’s source code.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Design Gradients (https://www.designgradients.com/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 盯住第一张紫色卡，看左下角起止色值和复制图标

Visual details from source observation: 我们先看首页的背景用途说明与紫红蓝橙四张色卡，再下滚比较灰、黄绿、深灰、粉紫等组合。第一张紫色卡标注起止HEX与复制图标，适合找背景颜色方向；右下角推广不算本库内容。48组是原站声明，本次没有逐项清点，也未核剪贴板复制结果。网页明确免费，但许可和商用范围仍未知，配色输出不等于平台程序源码。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
